newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates up.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates up.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell by 1.096 million barrels to 10.664 milllion barrels in the week ending March 26, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Light distillate stocks soared by 1.497 million barrels to 6.704 million barrels -- highest since stocks were 6.817 million barrels in the week ending July 17, 1996.
Light distillates comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 342,000 barrels to 6.128 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
